slides.headline: YOUR [[BANDMATES]] ARE WAITING.
slides.body: Two days. One original song. A room full of instruments.

slides.headline: [[EXPLORE]].
slides.body: Try instruments. Find your role in the group. Shape ideas together. No theory, no sitting and listening.

slides.headline: BRING IT TO [[LIFE]].
slides.body: The song you wrote — played together, start to finish.

slides.headline: NO SOLO [[PRESSURE]].
slides.body: Nobody's singled out. Groups are kept deliberately small so every voice actually gets heard.

slides.footnote:
Spots are limited.
Cost a barrier? Email Dave for a full or partial place — no questions asked.
